final_objective: Deliver a fully local, recoverable, traceable, customer-ready high-school mathematics question-bank and paper-generation product with all M0-M5 gates passed through real user workflows.
required_capabilities: versioned paper blueprints with question type, score, knowledge, method, difficulty, year, and expected-time constraints
single-source generation of student paper, teacher paper, answer booklet, solution booklet, and answer sheet
original-image plus reviewed SVG and TikZ figure tracks for geometry, function, and statistics diagrams
local structured, full-text, similarity, and semantic search with human-approved formal tags
controlled template editor, font calibration, and visual-regression dashboard
one-click verified backup and staging restore for database, in-project originals, derived assets, templates, and export snapshots

run_state_schema.pre_m0_meaning: planning, safety-contract publication, dependency preflight, and long-run entry audit; PRE_M0 is not one of the six delivery milestones
run_state_schema.implementation_status_field: records NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, or COMPLETE independently from the operational status

immutable_rules: D:\AAA命题 is read-only for project data and reference assets except that D:\AAA命题\Test is the sole project-data and runtime write root
the only non-project-root write exception is a separately audited dependency package-manager transaction; it never permits project data or scripts to write outside project_root
external references requiring processing must be copied into Copy with source and destination SHA-256 before processing
originals and published versions are never overwritten
business deletion uses quarantine; automated permanent deletion is forbidden
business data is processed locally and is never uploaded to external services
formal tags require human approval and evidence bound to a specific content revision
blueprint hard constraints are never silently relaxed
tests alone never establish completion; real user workflows and recovery drills are mandatory
M5 completion requires an offline fresh-user customer workflow and a verified deliverable package
hard_stop_conditions: a write target cannot be proven to resolve inside project_root
a write path contains or traverses a reparse point, junction, symbolic link, UNC path, device path, ADS, or traversal segment
actual write scope differs from the audited manifest
database integrity, backup verification, or restore rehearsal fails
free disk space cannot hold the old state, candidate state, and recovery checkpoint
any evidence suggests a project or runtime write outside project_root, or a dependency installer writes outside its approved package-manager manifest
a required operation would upload business data or expose personal information
a required Git operation would rewrite remote history or directly mutate the protected main branch
customer workflow evidence contradicts automated test results

dependency_install_policy.preferred_location: project-local portable tool or virtual environment inside project_root
dependency_install_policy.conditional_exception: allowed only after an audit proves that absence blocks an approved requirement and records source, exact version, license, hash, write locations, privileges, rollback, and tests
dependency_install_policy.scope_boundary: only the approved package-manager or installer transaction may write its own program files, cache, PATH registration, and uninstall metadata outside project_root; project data, scripts, logs, models, and outputs remain confined to project_root
must_pause_for: drivers, services, shell extensions, security-policy changes, or file-association changes
license terms incompatible with local customer delivery
installer writes cannot be bounded or audited

never_commit: PII, secrets, tokens, credentials, or browser state

completion_requires: all five generated artifact types agree on question revisions, numbering, scores, answers, and provenance
visual gold set and font substitution checks pass
semantic search gold set and formal-tag governance pass
verified backup restore followed by successful fixed user workflows
offline fresh-user end-to-end journey passes without developer shortcuts
zero audited project or runtime writes outside project_root; separately approved dependency-manager transactions are accounted for in their own manifests
customer package, manuals, license inventory, limitations, recovery guide, and evidence manifest are complete
